Commentary.Commentary: For the Aussies, everyone was amongst the wickets. Starc was the pick of the bowlers with 3 wickets while Zampa and Head took a couple each. The rest chipped in with one wicket each and hence, helped Australia restrict Sri Lanka to a total below 200. The visitors look like they can easily take this total down but with Finch injured and doubtful to come out and bat, anything could be possible. Let's hope the weather stays out of the way and gives us a good final game of the ODI series.

Dhananjaya de Silva and Gunathilaka started off strongly putting up 73 runs before the former departed. However, the strong start proved nothing as the next few batsmen got starts but did not convert them to anything fruitful. Only Mendis looked menacing but even he could not put up a big score to push Sri Lanka into good position. So after their best start of the series, Sri Lanka tumbled to their lowest score after batting first in this series.

Brilliant bowling display once again by the Aussies and they prove just why they're the World Champions! After winning the toss and opting to bat first, Sri Lanka got off to their best start of the series and looked to be up to something, well, so did the weather. However, both signs were deceptive as neither Sri Lanka nor the rain threatened Australia in the end.

OUT! In the air... taken! Boland removes Pathirana and Sri Lanka have been bowled out here. Fuller ball served in the channel on off, Pathirana looks to go over mid off but didn't timed it well. Faulkner stationed at mid off moves a couple of steps back and grabs it with ease. SRI LANKA BOWLED OUT FOR 195!
Good length ball on middle, defended by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
POWERPLAY 3 signalled! 5 fielders allowed outside the circle.
Will take a single now! Fullish on off, Pathirana glides it down to third man and will keep strike.
SP defends it from within the crease.
No damage done! Fuller ball outside off, Pathirana makes room and slices it behind point. Is happy to be on strike.
Free Hit coming up...

FOUR! Beamer! Starc bowls a high full toss on off, Pathirana easily arches back, opens the face of the bat and dabs it towards third man for a boundary. Starc says sorry and a smile in returns from Sachith. What we have next?
Yorker on middle, Pathirana digs it out on the leg side.
Full toss outside off, Sachith slashes it through point and doesn't bother running again.
Fuller length ball on off, Pathirana chips it uppishly towards covers. Does a sensible work here, doesn't run.
Fuller on middle and leg, flicked through the leg side.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Fuller length delivery on off, Pathirana smashes this one through covers for a boundary. He will need to face maximum number of balls, if Sri Lanka have to put up a decent target on the board.
Outside off, dabbed towards the man at point.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Good length ball on off, punched through covers for a single.
No he doesn't! Amila Aponso survives here! Fuller ball on off, Aponso does well to not allow Starc to pick up a Hat-Trick.
AMILA APONSO is the last man in to face the Hat-trick ball.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Mitchell Starc is on a roll here! He has got one aim and the aim is to hit the stumps. Once again bowls a fuller ball on middle, Lakmal looks to bring his bat down and defend but is a bit late to do so. The ball disturbs the furniture behind. Faulkner has picked up a Hat-Trick in this series already, can Starc do it too?
SURANGA LAKMAL is the new man in!

OUT! That's where Starc can hurt you, he is just too good at it. Comes from round the wicket and bowls a fuller ball outside off. It nips back in, poor Perera tries to defend it but is completely beaten by pace. The ball crashes into the stumps and Starc isn't even celebrating.
Length ball on middle and leg, Sachith clips it off his hips towards backward square leg for a single.
Wide! Full and sprayed down the leg side, the ball slipped out of his hand, maybe the ball is wet. The ball goes down the leg side and Pathirana still goes after it.
Angles a length ball on middle, flicked towards the man at short mid-wicket.
Short of a length ball on off, tapped towards point.
MITCHELL STARC is called back into the attack!
Tossed up around middle and off, defended off the front foot.
Loopy ball around leg, swept down to fine leg for a single.
On middle and off, Pathirana defends it down.
On middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! If the previous ball was mistimed, this goes off the meat of the bat! Another full toss around middle, Sachith skips down the track and spanks it over Zampa's head for a boundary. Two-in-two for SP!

FOUR! Just over Starc! A full toss around off, Pathirana comes down the track and looks to go over mid off. Didn't time it that well but still manages to hit it over Starc at mid off. Starc then gives it a chase, slides and rolls the ball back into play. Replays show Starc's foot made contact with the rope when he made a save. A boundary signalled by the umpire.
DP has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Slower one around off, Perera comes forward to defend but is beaten up the lack of pace there.
Little bit of width was on offer there, Pathirana cuts it through backward point for a single.
Fullish on off, driven through covers for a single.
Fuller length ball on off, Dilruwan gets forward and defends it towards Bailey at point.
Wide! Short of a length ball on off, Perera ducks under it.
Good length ball on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Off the mark in style! Drops it short around middle, Perera gets back in a jiffy and pulls it through mid-wicket for a racy boundary. Not what Zampa would have wanted to bowl after picking up a wicket on the previous ball.
DILRUWAN PERERA is the new man in!

OUT! Knocked him over! Adam Zampa strikes and gets his second scalp! Bowls a loopy ball around middle and off, Shanaka thought it would turn and was looking to run it down to third man. But the ball doesn't, just skids a bit and goes on to hit the off pole. Sri Lanka in all sorts of trouble here.
Tossed up around middle, Pathirana sweeps it through backward square leg for one.
Comes down the track and flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
Wide! Tossed up around middle, Shanaka looks to flick but misses.
On middle and leg, defended watchfully.
This is something what we don't want. And it has started to drizzle....
Full around middle, Shanaka defends it down.
It's gone gloomy out there! The floodlights are turned on, the groundstaff is ready too.
Fuller length ball on off, Pathirana cuts it through point for a double.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Sachith chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Angles it on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

Edged but doesn't carry! On a length and around off, Slower in pace. Pathirana gets squared up and ends up getting a thick outside edge which doesn't carry to Head at first slip. Bounces in front of him and runs down to third man for a single.
Good length ball on off, Shanka dabs it behind point for a single.
Loopy ball around off, Pathirana opens the face of the bat and glides it down to third man for another couple.
Short and around off, punched off the back foot through covers for a double.
Flattish on leg, SP looks to flick but misses as the ball goes off his pads.
Pathirana gets a bottom edge of the bat on that one.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Aggression upfront! Tossed up around middle, Shanaka comes down the track and hoicks it over mid-wicket. My colleague got to excited and screamed, that's a biggie and much to his dismay the ball bounced before crossing the ropes. Poor lad, his excitement got killed in a matter of seconds. Nevertheless, a boundary on the very first ball of the over.
Fuller and outside off, defended watchfully.
Fuller on middle and leg, Sachith drives it towards mid on.
Good length ball on off, Pathirana looks to defend but the ball goes just past the outside edge to Wade.
On a length and outside off, pushed towards point.
Pathirana was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Good length ball on middle, tucked towards square leg for a single.
JAMES FAULKNER is back on!
SACHITH PATHIRANA is the new man in!

OUT! The decision stays as it is! Loopy ball around middle, skids on with the angle. Perera lunges forward to defend but misses and is hit on the pads right in front of the stumps. Head appeals for an LBW and the umpire gives it out straightaway. Perera wasn't happy with the decision and hence opts for the review. The TV umpire after having a lot of views at the replays, decides there was no inside edge. The ball tracker had no scenes, it was pitched in line and was going on to hit the wickets. Three reds and KP has to walk back.
Kusal Perera is given out LBW but he has opted for the review straightaway. Looks out though.
Loopy ball around middle and off, Perera fails to make any contact.
Gets behind the line and defends it off the front foot gently.
FOUR! Edged but safe! Touch short and around off, Perera camps back to cut but gets an outside edge past the vacant first slip for a boundary.
Loopy ball around middle and off, Perera camps back to cut but gets a bottom edge on the off side.
Kusal Perera comes down the track and bunts it back to Head.
On middle and leg, played towards the leg side for a single.
Outside off, played off the foot and into the ground.
Bouncer, Perera ducks in time to let it go over him.
Outside off, Shanaka goes for it and gets an outside edge. The ball goes through the slip region, that would have been an easy catch. Single taken in the end.
Good length ball on middle, defended off the back foot by Shanaka.
Leg bye. That hits him low on the pads and the ball goes to the leg side, They take a single and get the leg byes.
Full on middle, defended off the front foot presenting the full face of the bat.
Full on middle and leg, Shanaka plays the slog sweep and gets a couple.
Full outside off, played towards the point region for a single.
Full on middle, played towards mid on for a single.
On middle, played towards mid-wicket but straight to the fielder.
Down the leg side, straight to the fielder though.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers, no runs.
Wide. This was way down the leg side by Starc. Umpire calls it wide straight away.
Yorker by Starc this time, Perera managed to keep this one out of the way.

FOUR! That was a dropped chance there! That was a full length ball outside off and Perera went for the flashy drive. He gets an outside edge which goes towards  Finch at first slip. He could not get down on time and the ball went through his fingers for a boundary. It seems like Finch has injured himself with that effort and walks out for treatment.
Bouncer! Perera leaves it alone, good decision that!
Good length ball on middle, Perera defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, Perera shoulders his arms and lets it through.
MITCHELL STARC is back on!
Full on middle, flicked off his pads for no runs.
DASUN SHANAKA walks in next.

OUT! Head gets his man! That was a loopy ball on middle and off, Tharanga goes for a square drive but fails to keep it down. He could not get it up and over the fielder and neither could he find the gap. Zampa made no mistake there as he gobbled it down to dismiss Tharanga. Sri Lanka in trouble once again!
Short of a length delivery, cut away through the square on the off side.
Full and on middle, driven towards the mid off for a single.
Fullish on middle, defended off the front foot by Perera this time.
Full on middle and off, driven towards the mid off for a single.
Defends this one by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length ball on middle, defended off the front foot by Perera.
Length ball outside off, Tharanga plays it with and angled bat and guides it to third man for a single.
Full on middle and leg this time, Perera works this one off his pads for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed towards covers for a single.
Bouncer! Tharanga does well to get out of the way of this delivery.
Full and outside off, Perera opens the face of the bat and helps it towards third man for a couple.
Full on middle and off, played off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on middle and off, driven towards mid off this time.
Gets right behind the line of the delivery and defends it well.
Full on middle and off, driven towards mid off for a single.
Outside off, slightly full, pushed towards covers.
TRAVIS HEAD to roll his arm now!
Good length ball on middle, Perera watchfully defends it off his front foot.
KUSAL PERERA walks in next.

OUT! Hastings gets his first wicket of the day and it is the danger man Mendis who is his prey. That was full outside off, Mendis who was confidently slaughtering these deliveries for boundaries could not time his drive this time. The ball took a faint outside edge and a regulation catch was not put down by Wade. A good innings comes to a sorry end.
Outside off and full, played towards the point region.
Back of a length, defended off the back foot.
Full outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Good length ball on middle, Tharanga defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on middle, driven towards mid-off.
Full on off, Mendis shows the full face of the bat to defend it off the back foot.
Outside off, played to the point region for a single.
On middle and leg, flicked away down the leg side for an easy single.
That was close! Full outside off and Mendis went for it but missed it completely.
Length ball on middle, played off the front foot and into the ground.
Fullish on middle, flicked away off the pads for a single.
FOUR! Top shot this! Fullish on off and Mendis lofts it over mid off confidently for a boundary. Superbly done by Mendis and he looks to be thorn for the Aussies at the moment.
Full on middle, flicked off his pads but no runs.
Fullish on middle, defended off the front foot by Mendis.
Full on outside off, played towards point.
Length ball on middle, defended by Mendis comfortably.
Full on middle, driven towards the mid off region for no runs.
On a length, defended by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, played towards point for a single by Mendis.
Good length ball on middle, defended superbly by Mendis.
FOUR! Fullish ball on off, Mendis did not look too comfortable with that. He went to defend but the ball took an outside edge and went through the vacant slip cordon and ran away for the boundary.
Good length ball on off, played towards point.
BOLAND comes on to bowl.
Shortish ball on middle and off, Tharanga looks to guide it towards third man but does not connect too well. The ball goes to the off side, no runs.
Slightly full on middle, defended off the front foot by Tharanga.
On middle and leg, flicked away off the pads for a couple.
Full outside off, Mendis pushes it to the cover region for a single.
Good length ball on middle, Mendis defends it smartly.
Outside off this time, Tharanga plays it with an angled bat and guides it towards third man. He gets a single for the effort.
HASTINGS is back into the attack!
Good comeback by Zampa, loopy ball on middle, defended nicely by Mendis. Good over for the Lankans, 13 off it.
FOUR! Looks like Mendis has decided to go after Zampa. This was loopy on middle and Mendis sweeps it away for a boundary through deep mid-wicket.
Loopy ball on middle, driven towards the mid on region for a single.
Once again plays the pull, gets only a single this time.
SIX! Full toss on middle and Mendis does not relent. He pulls it hard and high over mid-wicket and manages to get the ball all the way over the ropes.
Full toss this time, driven towards the mid on region for a single.
Good length ball on middle, defended off the front foot nicely by Mendis.
Loopy on middle, driven to the mid off region this time.

FOUR! Streaky stuff this! This was short, just the delivery that dismissed Chandimal. However, unlike his countryman, Mendis connects well with his upper cut and gets four runs for it as the ball crosses the ropes on the bounce. Faulkner was stationed at third man but could not get there in time.
Once again wide outside off, Mendis wants nothing to do with it.
Another one outside off, Mendis goes for it but misses.
Outside off, Mendis leaves it alone.
Defends this one by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
This was very well played by Mendis. He initially went for a flick but adjusted as the ball pitched on middle and swept it away at the last minute for a single.
Loopy ball on middle, it has been driven through mid on for a quick single.
Full toss this time, Zampa tried too hard probably and could not pitch it where he wanted. Tharanga drives it through the covers for an easy single.
Shows the full face of the bat to defend this ball which was on middle3 and leg.
Loopy ball on middle, defended by Tharanga off his front foot.
Good length ball on middle, defended off the front foot this time.

FOUR! What a beautiful cover drive there, he played it to perfection like a master. That was full, outside off and Mendis got down on one foot to elegantly drive it through the covers for the boundary.
Shortish outside off, Mendis leaves it alone.
On middle and leg, Tharanga plays it to fine leg for a single and gets off the mark straight away.
UPUL THARANGA walks in next.
Drinks are on the field!

OUT! Chandimal is a goner! That was a shortish ball on off and moving away from the batsman. Chandimal, the new man in the middle could have opted to leave it and judge the bounce before playing such shots. Instead, he decided to go for it by attempting a cut shot. The ball took the edge and went in the gloves of the keeper, easy take for Wade there and he made no mistake. Sri Lanka in trouble now!
Good length ball outside off, played straight to point.
MITCHELL STARC is back on!
Tossed up around middle and leg, Chandimal flicks it towards square leg for a single.
The skipper, DINESH CHANDIMAL is the new man in!

OUT! Bowled 'em! Tossed up around middle, Gunathilaka gets down and looks to paddle sweep it. The ball skids off the surface, beats the shot and hits the leg stump. Gunathilaka was beaten by pace there and Zampa is all pumped up. Both the Lankan openers are back in the hut now.

Good work in the deep by Finch! Drops it short around middle, Dansuhak camps back and pulls it towards mid-wicket. Finch form long on gets across to his left and does well to save a couple for his side.
Flattish around middle, Dansuhka defends it down.
Drops it short on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, Gunathilaka flicks it towards fine leg for a single.

Mendis would have been a goner! Fuller length ball on middle, Mendis drives it towards mid on and sets off for a single. Gunathilaka wasn't interested and sends him back. There is a shy at the striker's end but Mendis makes it in.
KUSAL MENDIS walks in to bat next.

OUT! In the air... gone! Faulkner provides a breakthrough and a gorgeous opening stand comes to an end. James comes from round the wicket and hurls it on middle. de Silva looks to loft it over mid on but was too early into the shot. Goes straight into the hands of Starc there who doesn't miss many. Faulkner is all smiles here as Australia get their first wicket.
On a length and around off, de Silva guides it towards point.
Opens the face of the bat and dabs it down to third man for a single.
DG has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Slower one outside off, Danushka looks to defend but fails to do so.
Loopy ball around middle, Gunathilaka gets across and paddle sweeps it towards short fine leg for a single.
On middle and leg, eased down to long on for a single.
Flattish on middle and leg, tucked towards the leg side for a single.
Tossed up around off, pushed towards mid off for a single.
On middle and off, defended back to the bowler.
Loopy ball around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for one.
ADAM ZAMPA into the attack!

Chance goes abegging! Good length ball on off, slower in pace. de Silva looks to flick but gets a leading edge back to the bowler. Faulkner stretches his left arm to take that one but the ball was too far from his reach. de Silva was half way down the track and the fielder at mid off quickly throws it towards the striker's end. Wade tries to deflect it on to the stumps but Dhananjaya makes his way till then.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A length ball outside off, de Silva fails to put his bat on ball.
Slower one around off, DG guides it towards third man for a single.
Good length ball on middle, tucked towards the leg side for a single.

Chance of a run out! Fuller length delivery served around off, Gunathilaka gets forward and drives it towards mid off and sets off for a quick single. The fielder stationed there, gets to the ball and fires a throw at the bowler's end. It misses but a superb piece of backup was on display by Finch there. A risky single taken.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller length ball on off, driven through covers for a single.
Nearly chopped on! Good length ball on off, Gunathilaka looks to defend but gets an inside edge as the ball rolls over the stumps to the keeper.
FOUR! Easy picking that! A length delivery, strayed down the leg side, Boland just helps it on its way down to fine leg. That raced away to the fence for a boundary.
Touch short and outside off, punched through covers for a single.
On a length and outside off, de Silva defends it down.
PowerPlay 2 signalled. Maximum 4 fielders allowed outside the circle.
Fuller and angled on the pads, worked through mid-wicket by de Silva to keep strike.
Wide! Short and going down the leg side, de Silva leaves it alone.
Back of a length ball on middle, de Silva gets behind the line and answers it with a straight bat.
Shortish on middle, clipped towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller ball on off, Gunathilaka drives it through covers. It was hit in the gap again and they pick up three this time.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller length ball on off, Gunathilaka pushes it towards covers. Head fails to stop it and Bailey then gives it a chase to keep them down to a brace.
Was there a chance? Fuller ball on middle, de Silva drives it back to the bowler who tried to grab it by bending down to his right but the ball goes through and the pair take a couple.
Good length ball on off, de Silva punches it sweetly through extra covers and comes back for an easy double.
Fuller length ball on off, driven towards mid off.
Fuller length delivery on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and around off, Gunathilaka guides it towards point.
Short of a length ball, angling in, de Silva tucks it towards the right of the bowler and scampers across for a single.
On a length and around off, at 134 kph, Gunathilaka looks to defend but is beaten comprehensively.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! Easily done! On a length and outside off, de Silva stands put and lofts it neatly over the man at mid off for a boundary. There was an element of risk involved but credit has to be given to the batsman.
Back of a length delivery on off, de Silva defends it off the back foot.
Fuller length delivery on off, de Silva leans forward and defends it carefully.
Back of a length delivery on off, Dhanajaya defends it down.
JAMES FAULKNER into the attack as well.
Fuller length ball on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, punched off the back foot.
Landed outside off, dabbed towards point for a single.
Fuller length delivery on off, Gunathilaka defends it off the front foot.
Danushka was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Back of a length ball on off, DG opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a couple.
SCOTT BOLAND into the attack now, replacing Starc.
Touch short and outside off, Gunathilaka punches it towards covers. The fielder looks to stop but the ball bursts off his palms and they take a single.
FOUR! Classy shot! Too short and too wide outside off, Gunathilaka hops a bit in the crease and slaps it over covers. One bounce and into the fence she goes.
Angles it on the pads, flicked through the leg side for a single.
Good length ball on off, slight away movement there. de Silva looks to poke at it but gets beaten up.

Back of a length ball on off, Gunathilaka cuts it towards point where the fielder dives full length to his right but could only get a hand on to that one. However, three runs have been taken. Good running between the wickets.
On a length and outside off, Gunathilaka guides it towards point for no runs.
Fuller length delivery on middle, de Silva flicks it over mid-wicket for a couple.
Touch short and outside off, flayed through backward point for one.
Leg bye! Full and on the pads, de Silva looks to flick but misses as the ball brushes off his pads and rolls down to fine leg. They appeal but it was pitched outside leg. A leg bye is taken.
Fuller length ball on off, de Silva drives it towards covers and this time Bailey makes a great stop to deny them a single.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Bowls a low full toss on the pads, de Silva walks across and flicks it elegantly through mid-wicket. The fielder dives full length to his right to stop but fails to do so.
FOUR! Carved! An overpitched delivery in the channel outside off, de Silva chips it over covers for a one bounce boundary. No need to run for those.
Short of a length ball on off, Gunathilaka taps it in front of the man at point.
DG plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man.

SIX! Down town! That was a superb shot from Gunathilaka! Good length delivery on off, Danushka stands inside the crease and hits it over the bowler's head for a biggie all the way. Certainly a confidence inducing shot.
Angles it on the pads, worked through the on side for an easy single.
It's gone very overcast at the moment. Remember, showers were predicted and it's not looking good at the moment.
Back of a length delivery outside off, de Silva defends it off the back foot.
On a length and outside off, dabbed behind poinjt for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller length ball on off, driven towards covers.
Beaten! Good length delivery on off, shapes away this time. de Silva comes forward to defend but the ball just whizzes past his outside edge to the keeper.

A loud shout for lbw! Angles a length delivery on middle, de Silva looks to flick it across the line but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal is made by Starc but it's turned down by the umpire.
Wide! On a length and moves away after pitching. Actually too wide outside off, de Silva has no problem leaving it alone.
In the channel outside off, de Silva lifts his bat and lets it go.
On a length and around off, Dhanajaya defends it nicely off the back foot towards the off side.
Back of a length ball on off, Gunathilaka punches it off the back foot towards covers. A maiden to start the proceedings for Hastings, then!
On a length and around off, pushed towards point where the fielder dives to his left and makes a good stop.
Fuller length delivery on off, DG gets on the front foot and defends it gently.
On a length and outside off, Gunathilaka gets back and plays with an angled bat towards point.
Back of a length ball outside off, Gunathilaka taps it towards covers.
Fuller ball on off, Danushka pushes it towards covers.
JOHN HASTINGS, Man of the Match from the last game will bowl from the other end!

FOUR! Superbly driven! What a way to get off the mark! Fuller ball in the channel on off, at 144 kph, de Silva leans into it and drills it through covers for a superb boundary. Lovely shot. So, Starc doesn't get a wicket in his very first over this time.
Good length ball on off, Dhanajaya gets back and defends it down.
Full and too wide outside off, de Silva has got nothing to do with that one.
Touch full and around off, driven towards covers.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, de Silva shoulders his arms to that one.
Starts with a full length delivery from over the wicket and outside off, easy leave for de Silva there.

We are all set to get underway then. The umpires and players have made their way out to the middle. DHANANJAYA DE SILVA and DANUSHKA GUNATHILAKA are the Lankan openers. MITCHELL STARC to start off with the bowling proceedings with a couple of slips in place. Here we go...
TEAM CHANGES - Australia are unchanged from their last game.
Pitch Report - Damien Martyn says there is very less grass on the surface with some patches on it. Ends by saying we are set for a cracking game.

STEVEN SMITH says even he would have batted first as the wicket looks good. Informs they are going with the same team. Is really happy with the way his boys have performed. Further says they have done a good job until now and is hoping that his bowlers will restrict the home side to an achievable total. Ends by saying he is eyeing to win it 4-1 instead of 3-2.

DINESH CHANDIMAL says they will bat first. Adds the wicket looks good and they would look to put up a good total, somewhere near 250. Focuses on the point that they need to get good starts. Ends by saying they have made 4 changes today and is unhappy as their skipper got ruled out.
SRI LANKA WIN THE TOSS AND FOR THE 5TH TIME IN A ROW THEY WILL BAT!

There are some worrying signs for the home side as their skipper Mathews is ruled out of the series due to an injury. Thisara Perera and Lakshan Sandakan won't be a part of this game too. Australia in all likelihood won't fiddle around with the winning combination and mostly will go with the same playing XI. The weather forecast isn't pleasing at all as showers are predicted throughout the day. Let's hope they stay away and we get a full day's play. Toss coming up in a while.

Hello and a warm welcome for the fifth and final ODI between Sri Lanka and Australia at Pallekele. The series is done and dusted in the favour of the Aussies and this game is more or less a dead rubber but the hosts will play for pride.
